evidence.report: Inspected all 24 revision 003 render frames and all 24 references. The latest render improves muzzle alignment, late hand placement, and the coat's rounded outline, but the early rear-view coat still obscures the boots and the opening smoke remains sparse. This targeted candidate narrows and asymmetrically lifts the early coat hem and thickens the opening background haze, preserving the later coat, camera, poses, and full absolute-time timeline. Remaining limitations include coarse actor proportions, simplified fabric folds and impact close-ups, approximate backgrounds and optical bullet wakes, and inferred unsampled motion. This candidate is unrendered.
